name: GPTBot
purpose: Crawls content that may be used to train OpenAI's generative AI foundation models.

name: OAI-SearchBot
purpose: Surfaces websites in ChatGPT search results.

name: OAI-AdsBot
purpose: Checks landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

name: ChatGPT-User
purpose: Visits pages when ChatGPT or Custom GPT users ask questions or use GPT Actions.

name: ChatGPT agent
purpose: ChatGPT's browsing agent; identified by RFC 9421 signatures, not by User-Agent.

name: Claude-SearchBot
purpose: Crawls the web to improve the quality of Claude's search results.

name: Claude-User
purpose: Fetches pages when a Claude user asks a question.

name: ClaudeBot
purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training Anthropic's models.

name: Perplexity-User
purpose: Fetches pages when a Perplexity user asks a question; generally ignores robots.txt.

name: PerplexityBot
purpose: Surfaces and links websites in Perplexity search results.

name: Google-Agent
purpose: Agents hosted on Google infrastructure that navigate the web and act on user request.

name: Google-Extended
purpose: robots.txt token controlling use of content for Gemini training and grounding; no separate crawler.

name: Googlebot
purpose: Google Search crawler; its index also feeds Google's AI features.

name: Applebot-Extended
purpose: robots.txt token controlling use of crawled data to train Apple's foundation models; does not crawl.

name: Applebot
purpose: Apple's crawler for Siri, Spotlight and Safari search features.

name: Bingbot
purpose: Bing search crawler; its index also grounds Copilot answers.

name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
purpose: Fetches individual links at a user's request, including for agentic AI tasks.

name: Meta-WebIndexer
purpose: Analyzes content to improve Meta AI search results and citations.

name: Meta-ExternalAgent
purpose: Crawls for training foundation AI models and product indexing.

name: FacebookExternalHit
purpose: Fetches shared links to build previews (title, description, thumbnail).

name: CCBot
purpose: Builds the Common Crawl open web archive, widely used as AI training data.

name: Bytespider
purpose: ByteDance crawler associated with AI model data collection.

name: Amazonbot
purpose: Amazon crawler used for Alexa answers and other Amazon services.

name: PetalBot
purpose: Crawler for Huawei's Petal Search.

name: DuckAssistBot
purpose: Fetches pages to answer questions in DuckDuckGo's AI-assisted answers.

name: MistralAI-User
purpose: Fetches pages when Le Chat users ask questions.
